name: ARCH2S
description: Precise segmentation of architectural structures provides detailed information about various building components, enhancing our understanding and interaction with our built environment. Nevertheless, existing outdoor 3D point cloud datasets have limited and detailed annotations on architectural exteriors due to privacy concerns and the expensive costs of data acquisition and annotation. To overcome this shortfall, this paper introduces a semantically-enriched, photo-realistic 3D architectural models dataset and benchmark for semantic segmentation. It features 4 different building purposes of real-world buildings as well as an open architectural landscape in Hong Kong. Each point cloud is annotated into one of 14 semantic classes.
evaluation_method: mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) and per-class IoU on point cloud labels
reputation: Very recently released; likely limited adoption so far but relevant to researchers working on architectural point-cloud segmentation and synthetic-to-real transfer.
notes: non-LLM benchmark; photo-realistic synthetic 3D models may have domain gap to real-world scans; moderate dataset size and 14 classes can cause class imbalance; annotation quality likely high but real-world variability may be underrepresented.
